text: [60] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato dullabho vuḍḍhapabbajito katamehi pañcahi dullabho bhikkhave vuḍḍhapabbajito suvaco dullabho suggahitaggāhī dullabho padakkhiṇaggāhī dullabho dhammakathiko dullabho vinayadharo imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato dullabho vuḍḍhapabbajitoti . nīvaraṇavaggo paṭhamo . tassuddānaṃ āvaraṇaṃ rāsi aṅgāni samayaṃ [1]- mātuputtikā upajjhāṭṭhānakumārā 2 licchavī apare duveti . ________________ saññāvaggo dutiyo
